title: Second Conditional
rule: Use the second conditional for unreal or unlikely situations.
pattern: If + past simple, would + base verb

examples.text: If I had money, I would travel.
If she knew, she would help.
Would you move if you could?
If we lived near the sea, we would swim daily.
He wouldn't buy it if it were expensive.

practicePrompt: Complete: If I ___ (be) you, I would apologize.
